I propose that we implement a new rule to ensure the sustainability of our fish stock. Here's my suggestion: 1. Once the fish population reaches 80 tons, we can reassess and potentially increase the catch limit, but it should never exceed 10 tons per fisherman per month to maintain sustainability. This approach will allow the fish population to regenerate more effectively, ensuring that we can all continue to earn a stable income over time.
